Both a dentist and a server agreed to help raise money for their local library. Though the dentist was really helpful in the organization and running of several different events and raised a ton of money in the end, the server was more trouble than they were worth and ended up mixing up dates, forgetting when they needed to complete different tasks, and really just couldn't do anything helpful at all. Who is competent?
A. Not answerable
B. The dentist
C. The server
